title: custom launch arguments (required for mod)
body:
Hi again !

Thanks for this awesome app, it runs great on my M5 base chip.

Would it be possible to add a way to customize DLL Overrides (like version=n,b which is mandatory to run Cyber Engine Tweaks)?
Either by letting us add custom launch arguments to our games, or by allowing the "Run a Windows program" tool to execute .bat scripts.

Adding WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%
in Steam Launch Options brings Filenotfound error

Thanks a lot for your amazing work!
